home_subhead: I help companies build relationships with their audiences. I communicate their story, keeping it consistent everywhere it shows up. From the homepage and the product, to email and the founder's voice, I make complex, technical ideas easy to trust.
cases_intro: Brand voice is only as good as its range. One voice reaching across multiple industries and external channels, from a case study made for Retool to an email campaign and founder story for an insurtech to a fabricator's product catalog.
work_intro: I write brand voice for companies with something complex to explain. My work spans marketing campaigns, product and web copy, and founder storytelling, and at NYT Wirecutter it means turning technical product testing into clear copy read by millions.
